checks.rationale: Breeze publishes hand-written HTML, not a machine-readable specification. Argument tables can contradict examples; HTTP GET also performs writes. Review the reference against READ_ENDPOINTS and the named tools' paths before accepting changes.

evidence.notes: The Tags section's List People points back at /people. Giving, funds, and pledges left the public reference around September 2023; their parameters remain based on the archived vendor reference and corroborating pyBreezeChMS list_contributions/list_funds implementations. Unauthenticated 403 proves only the controller exists, not that each action works.
